profile_text.body:
# Salesforce

Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. According to its website, the company describes Slack AI as a tool that helps teams boost productivity by summarizing chats, searching files, taking meeting notes, translating conversations, and automating workflows. The company emphasizes that "AI in Slack is smart enough to help, and subtle enough to never get in the way," and positions organizational data accumulated in shared conversation history as a trusted source of knowledge. Slack AI features are available across all paid Slack plans.

The company's AI product portfolio includes Slack AI for team messaging and collaboration, Salesforce Einstein/Agentforce for CRM-embedded AI and agents, and Tableau AI (Einstein) for business intelligence with natural language query capabilities. Slack AI operates within Slack's trusted boundary on AWS, and the company states that customer data is not used to train large language models, with LLM providers having no access to customer data. Agentforce agents can run directly in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages to query data and trigger actions.

Salesforce reported last revenue of $41.525 billion for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, and trades on the public market under ticker CRM. The company faces 208 active lawsuits or regulatory matters in California. Six MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers related to Salesforce are registered, supporting SOQL queries, data retrieval, and deployment pipeline management.
